title: Pika's First Open Weight Video Model H3 Flex Takes No. 7 Spot on DesignArena
summary:
Pika Labs' latest generative AI release earned a 1293 Elo rating on the DesignArena Video leaderboard, ranking it as the top open weight video model currently on the board. The tool, known as H3 Flex, placed No. 7 overall, surpassing lauding benchmarks for competing models such as FLUX 3 Video and Minimax H3.

The new model supports resolutions up to 4k and produces exportable audio stems, allowing the company to generate a 15 second clip with a soundtrack in as little as 7 seconds. Pika said the system is designed for professional iteration, and DesignArena noted the model's particular strengths in portraits and product-centered videos.

BREAKING: Pika H3 Flex by @pika_labs lands at #7 on DesignArena's Video leaderboard!

Pika H3 Flex scored a 1293 Elo rating, just ahead of FLUX 3 Video, Minimax H3 Max, and Minimax H3. It is also the highest ranking open-weights video model on the board. Pika H3 Flex also exhibited strengths for complicated camera motion, background details, product-centered videos, and portraits.

Congrats to the @pika_labs team on the launch!
